crossRefs.note: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

parallels.note: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
translations.bsb: The weight of gold that came to Solomon each year was 666 talents,
translations.kjv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
translations.asv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
